rules.statement: Section 718 of the Civil Procedure Code can be applied to cases where an administrator claims property as his own, which a party to the testamentary suit alleges belongs to the estate.
rules.supporting_quote: "With great respect, I- would, therefore, say that de Zoysa v. de Zoysa (supra) was wrongly decided on this point, and that the second order of the District Judge was correct."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 718 of the Civil Procedure Code
